paras: Application: Subaru BRZ, Toyota GT86 / GR86, Scion FR-S (manual transmission only) Part Type: Fuel filter mount with heat exchanger Part Number: 20-0912

Hardware for installing a Radium Engineering fuel filter. The sheet metal bracket conforms to the chassis, using three OEM mounting points underneath the vehicle, just left of the transmission bell housing.
hl: OEM Mounting: Mounts to OEM threaded holes – no permanent modifications
Heat Exchanger: Anodised extruded aluminium heat exchanger in the cooling air flow
